problem.problem:
Charlie is big. Charlie is cold. Charlie is kind. Charlie is quiet. Charlie is red. Charlie is rough. Charlie is smart. Erin is kind. Fiona is quiet. Fiona is rough. Harry is kind. Harry is rough. Kind things are big. All kind, smart things are rough. If something is red and quiet then it is big. All red things are cold. All cold, quiet things are smart. If something is big and smart then it is cold. All quiet things are cold. Kind, big things are red. All cold, smart things are kind.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Fiona is not red.

Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?

Facts:
Big(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is big.
Cold(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is cold.
Kind(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is kind.
Quiet(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is quiet.
Red(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is red.
Rough(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is rough.
Smart(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is smart.
Kind(Erin, True) ::: Erin is kind.
Quiet(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is quiet.
Rough(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is rough.
Kind(Harry, True) ::: Harry is kind.
Rough(Harry, True) ::: Harry is rough.

Rules:
Kind($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: Kind things are big.
Kind($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: All kind, smart things are rough.
Red($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: If something is red and quiet then it is big.
Red($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All red things are cold.
Cold($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: All cold, quiet things are smart.
Big($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something is big and smart then it is cold.
Quiet($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All quiet things are cold.
Kind($x, True) && Big($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: Kind, big things are red.
Cold($x, True) && Smart($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: All cold, smart things are kind.

Query:
Red(Fiona, False) ::: Fiona is not red.
